executive_summary: An analysis of organic metrics, keyword gaps, and backlink profiles across DealCheck, Bricked.ai, and HouseCanary reveals substantial whitespace in high-intent commercial real estate software and valuation terms. DealCheck dominates transaction analysis terms (like IRR equations and deal screening) while HouseCanary captures high-volume market and valuation data. Bricked.ai targets niche AI and flipping tools. The core growth opportunity lies in capturing mid-difficulty, high-intent queries such as 'real estate flipping software', 'comparative market analysis tool', and core financial metric definitions like 'what is a cap rate', supported by a strong contextual backlink acquisition campaign leveraging high-authority real estate and proptech ecosystems.
